info.title: Fenergo Nebula Screening Adapter Receptor
info.description:
## Purpose of the API The purpose of the Screening Receptor API is to integrate the different Screening adapters (LN, WCO, etc) with the main Screening service, by receiving the results of the available Screening operations (Screen, Resolve Matches, Test, etc). Once the results are sent to the Receptor by the Adapters, they will forwarded to the main Screening service for them to be processed. ## Authentication The authentication in the Receptor is driven by the optional headers that are available in the endpoints (X-TENANT-ID, X-PROVIDER-ID, X-ENCRYPTION-IV, X-AUTHENTICATION-MAC). To authenticate the requests coming to the Receptor, two keys are used to encrypt and authenticate the request. There are a few things to take into account:
  • The keys have a size of 256 bit. These keys should be encoded in base64 format and added to the Screening configuration of the provider and tenant, using the Screening Command API
  • For authentication, HMAC (SHA256) is used
  • For encryption, AES-CBC is used
  • The order of the process is: Encrypt-then-MAC. This means that the request body must be encrypted first using the encryption key, and then authenticated using the authentication key
## Compression and Content-Type The Receptor API supports compressed and uncompressed request bodies. Users will need to provide appropriate values for the 'Compression-Algorithm' and 'Content-Type' headers depending on whether the request body is compressed or not:
  • If the header 'Compression-Algorithm' is not specified in the request or its value is an empty string, the API won't try to decompress the request body. In this case, the value 'application/json' should be specified in the 'Content-Type' header
  • If the header 'Compression-Algorithm' is not empty, the API will decompress the request body with the algorithm specified in the header. So far, the only supported algorithm is 'gzip'. In this case, the value 'text/plain' should be specified in the 'Content-Type' header. This online compression tool could be handy to get the compressed text from the JSON body: Gzip compression tool
The correct order to compress the request body is:
  1. Set the 'gzip' value in the 'Compression-Algorithm' header
  2. Set the 'text/plain' value in the ''Content-Type' header
  3. Get the strongly typed response object
  4. Serialize the strongly typed object to a JSON string
  5. Compress the JSON string using the gzip algorithm
  6. Convert the compressed stream to Base64 a string
  7. If authentication is enabled, encrypt the Base64 string and set the authentication headers accordingly. Otherwise, send the Base64 string directly
## Request payload limit The Receptor API has a maximum request payload limit of 6MB. If the payload size is greater than that (either compressed or uncompressed), the API will throw an error. ## Using Authentication and Compression together When both authentication and compression are used together, the order of the process is: Compress-Encrypt-MAC. This means that the request body must be compressed first, then encrypted using the encryption key, and finally authenticated using the authentication key. ## Troubleshooting errors The Receptor API performs some basic validations on the request that would give immediate feedback to the consumer of the API. For example, the consumer may get a 400 Bad Request error if some mandatory properties in the request body are missing. If the request is valid, the Receptor will return a 202 Accepted response. Even though the Receptor may return a successful response, errors could happen while processing the request in the Screening main service. In that scenario, it is possible to get the details of the errors that have occurred by using the Screening Query API. For example, the response of the 'api/batch/{id}' endpoint would include the error details if the 'Screen' results were not processed successfully.

post.summary: This method handles the results from the different screening adapters

parameters.name: X-TENANT-ID
parameters.description: The UiD of the tenant representing organization

parameters.name: X-ENCRYPTION-IV
parameters.description: The encryption IV key, base64 encoded

parameters.name: X-AUTHENTICATION-MAC
parameters.description: The authentication MAC key, base64 encoded

parameters.name: Compression-Algorithm
parameters.description:
The compression algorithm (if any) that has been used to compress the body of the request.

Possible values: empty string (if body is not compressed), gzip

400.description: Bad request. The request has missing/invalid values

source.description: Property to specify where the error is coming from

message.description: The error message to understand what has failed
message.example: The provider returned an invalid status code (500)

AdapterResponseErrorDetails.description: Class to represent the error details of a request to a Screening adapter

AdditionalInfoDto.description: Class to represent additional information returned by the providers

addressLine1.description: The first line in the address

addressLine2.description: The second line in the address

category.description:
The category of the address (e.g. Residential, Business, Headquarters, Ownership), as
reported by the underlying provider

AddressDto.description: Class to represent the address of an entity

externalId.description:
The unique identifier of the Associated Entity outside of Fen-X (i.e. in the underlying provider).
Used to query the underlying provider for more information about the associated entity.

fullName.description: The name of the associated party

relationship.description: How the entity and the associated party are related i.e shareholder, director

relationshipGroup.description: The relationship group as reported by the underlying provider (e.g. Family, Associations)

ownershipPercentage.description: The ownership percentage of the associated party, as reported by the underlying provider

AssociationDto.description: Class to represent a relationship with another entity

source.description: The source of this externalId (LN, WCO, etc)

name.description: The name of the ID in the provider

BatchExternalIdDto.description: Class to represent the batch external IDs fetched from the providers (runId, resultId, etc)

kind.description: The category this table's rows belong to

rows.description: The rows of this category's table

CategoryDetailDto.description: One category's worth of structured detail rows (e.g. every PEP hit for this match)

label.description: The display label for this field

CategoryDetailFieldDto.description: One labelled field within a category detail row (e.g. Label="Status", Value="Inactive")

fields.description: The labelled fields for this row

subRows.description:
Per-row sub-table, e.g. SOE's per-country ownership breakdown. Null/empty for every
category kind that has no such breakdown.

CategoryDetailRowDto.description: One row of a category detail table - one PEP hit, one Sanction hit, etc.

source.description: The source of this externalId (LN, WCO, etc)

entityAliasId.description: What entity Alias this externalId is associated with. Will be null or "PrimaryName" for the PrimaryName external ids

name.description: The name of the ID in the provider

ExternalIdDto.description: Class to represent the external IDs fetched from the providers (runId, resultId, etc)

type.description: The Type of Id of the entity

value.description: This is the Value of the ID of the entity

label.description: The human-readable name of the ID scheme, as reported by the underlying provider (e.g. the name of a registry or identifier scheme)

issueDate.description: Date on which Id is Issued.

MatchDataAliasDto.description: Class to represent the alias of an entity

externalId.description:
The unique identifier of the match outside of Fen-X (i.e. in the underlying provider). 

It will be used later on to resolve the matches on the provider side. 

If using Alias Screening, this will be the ExternalId of the first entity in which this match appears.
So instead of using this field, ExternalIds should be used, as it contains the ExternalId for each of the aliases the match belongs to.

externalIds.description:
The unique identifiers of the match outside of Fen-X (i.e. in the underlying provider). 

They will be used later on to resolve the matches on the provider side. There will be one (or more) ExternalId
for each of the entity alias ids related to this match

providerId.description:
The ID of the provider that returned the match. 

Must match the ID of the provider in the Screening configuration.

entityAliasIds.description:
List of the FenX Entity AliasIds that this match is associated with for Alias Screening feature.
When it's associated with the primary name of the entity, one of them will be "PrimaryName".
If the array is null or empty, it means that the match only belongs to the PrimaryName of the entity.

name.description: The name of the matching entity

aliases.description: Any aliases associated with the matching entity, formatted as a list of strings

aliasesList.description: Any aliases associated with the matching entity, formatted as a list of AliasDto

dateOfBirth.description: The Individual's date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format

dateOfBirthList.description: List of Individual's date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format from different Providers

matchScore.description: A confidence score generated by the screening provider to indicate how closely the result record matched the searched entity data.

providerSourceName.description:
The name of the screening provider. 

Should match the provider name provided in the Screening configuration

providerSourceUrl.description:
URL of the match on the provider side. 

Leave empty if the provider doesn't have a portal where the user could go to check the match details on their side

providerSourceUrls.description:
List of URL links to the match on the provider's side, each with an optional label. 

Leave empty if the provider doesn't have a portal where the user could go to check the match details on their side.

addresses.description: List of addresses of the individual or the company

placeOfBirthList.description: List of Individual's place of birth from different Providers

additionalInfo.description:
Dynamic list to provide additional information about the matching entity. 

The data provided here is rendered in the "Profile" section in the Fen-X UI.

sourcesInfo.description:
Dynamic list to provide details about the source of the information returned by the provider. 

The data provided here is rendered in the "Sources" section in the Fen-X UI, each occurrence having its own subsection based on the "Title" provided. 

If both Sources and SourcesInfo are sent, in the UI, Sources will be used and SourcesInfo will be ignored.

categories.description: List of screening categories that the result relates to

sources.description:
Dynamic list to provide details about the source of the information returned by the provider. 

The data provided here is rendered in the "Sources" section in the Fen-X UI. All occurrences are listed under a "Sources" subsection in the section. 

If both Sources and SourcesInfo are sent, in the UI, Sources will be used and SourcesInfo will be ignored.

registeredCountry.description: The country the company is registered in

ids.description: List of ids returned by the underlying provider

idsList.description: List of Ids returned by the underlying provider

associations.description: List of entities associated to the entity being screened

reason.description: The reason why the match has the status specified in the property "Status"

comments.description: Additional comments about the match resolution

subsidiaryFields.description: An optional dictionary used to add custom fields required by some adapters or providers

richTextAdditionalDetails.description: An optional property to store additional details about the match in rich text format

categoryDetails.description:
WC Data Plus structured category data (PEP, Sanction, Enforcement, Adverse Media, SOE,
Registration, Other), one entry per populated category kind that has at least one row.
Can be left null/empty for every other provider that don't need to provide structured category data.

MatchDataDto.description: Class to represent the details of a Screening match

entityAliasId.description: What entity Alias this externalId is associated with. Will be "PrimaryName" for the PrimaryName external ids

MatchDataExternalIdDto.description: Class to represent a match external id

id.description:
Field used to uniquely identify the request. It's value is different depending on the response type:
  • For the "Screen" and "ResolveMatches" types, it should be the Screening BatchId
  • For the "Test" type, it should be the Screening ConfigurationId
  • For the "OngoingScreeningGetResults" type, the BatchId is not available, so it should be an unique string that hasn't been used before. For example, "ogs-{auto-generated Guid}"

providerId.description: The Screening internal ID of the provider. Must match the ID of the provider in the configuration

status.description: Property used to specify the status of the request

response.description:
Generic property that represents the data of the response. 

The type to used will be determined by the type of response specified in the field "type". 

Must be `null` when !:UploadId is set — the receptor will download the
response payload from S3 using the upload ID instead of reading it from this field.

ObjectAdapterResponseDto.description: Class to represent a response from a Screening adapter

batchExternalIds.description: List of Batch-level external ids (i.e. IDs that are specific to the underlying providers and are equivalent to the "Batch" concept in Screening)

entityId.description: The Screening internal ID of the entity

legalEntityId.description: The unique ID of the entity in Fen-X

externalIds.description: List of Entity-level external ids (i.e. IDs that are specific to the underlying providers and are equivalent to the "Entity" concept in Screening)

matchesData.description: List of matches of the entity

configurationSetId.description: The ID of the configuration set used for this screening. If not provided, the default configuration set of the provider will be assumed

OngoingScreeningGetResultsResponseEntity.description: Class to represent the screening results of an entity

OngoingScreeningResponseDto.description:
Response for the "OngoingScreening" request type 

There are no properties in this class because no additional data is required to process it.

OngoingScreeningUpdateResponseDto.description:
Response for the "OngoingScreeningUpdate" request type 

There are no properties in this class because no additional data is required to process it.

url.description: URL of the match on the provider side.

entityAliasId.description: What entity Alias this ProviderSourceLink is associated with.

ProviderSourceLinkDto.description: Represents a URL link to the match on the provider's side, with an optional label.

ResolveMatchesResponseDto.description:
Response for the "ResolveMatches" request type 

There are no properties in this class because no additional data is required to process it.

batchExternalIds.description: List of Batch-level external ids (i.e. IDs that are specific to the underlying providers and are equivalent to the "Batch" concept in Screening)

entityId.description: The Screening internal ID of the entity

externalIds.description: List of Entity-level external ids (i.e. IDs that are specific to the underlying providers and are equivalent to the "Entity" concept in Screening)

matchesData.description: List of matches of the entity

ScreenResponseEntityDto.description: Class to represent the screening results of an entity

TestResponseDto.description:
Response for the "Test" request type. 

There are no properties in this class because no additional data is required to process it.

uploadId.description: Opaque token to include in the subsequent POST /api/receptor call.

uploadUrl.description:
Pre-signed S3 URL to upload the response payload. Make an HTTP PUT request to this URL
with the serialized `AdapterResponseDto.Response` field as the body — not the full
`AdapterResponseDto` envelope. The body must be raw UTF-8 JSON; do not compress or
encrypt it. Include all headers listed in Fenergo.Nebula.Screening.AdapterCommon.Receptor.Dto.UploadUrlResponseDto.RequiredHeaders.
Do not modify the URL. The upload must complete before Fenergo.Nebula.Screening.AdapterCommon.Receptor.Dto.UploadUrlResponseDto.ExpiresInSeconds elapses,
after which the URL is no longer valid.

requiredHeaders.description:
Headers that must be included verbatim in the PUT request to S3.
The receptor signs these into the pre-signed URL; omitting or altering
any of them causes S3 to reject the upload.
